notify.updateInstallingText: Version {version} is being installed. ClickIt will start again afterwards.

errors.updating: ClickIt is installing an update and is about to restart
errors.invalid: The scenario has errors. Fix the steps marked in red.
errors.queueInvalid: The queue has errors. Remove or replace the marked items.
errors.nothingToRun: No scenario or queue is selected to run
errors.blockedProcess: {process} from the "Do not run while running" list is running
errors.targetNotFocused: Could not bring window {target} to the foreground
errors.hotkeyInvalid: "{hotkey}" cannot be used as a hotkey
errors.hotkeyTaken: "{hotkey}" is already taken by another program
errors.hotkeySame: Start/stop and capture cannot share one key
errors.importBad: The file is not a ClickIt scenario: {message}
errors.regionTooSmall: The selected region is too small
errors.stepLimit: The scenario already has {max} steps, no more can be added
errors.cornerStop: Stopped: cursor in the top-left corner
errors.conditionTimeout: The condition was not met before the timeout (step {step})
errors.pointOutsideTarget: Point {x}, {y} is outside the target window (step {step})
errors.inputFailed: Windows rejected the input (step {step}). The window may be running as administrator.
errors.captureOutsideTarget: The cursor is outside the target window. Point at the window content and try again.
errors.scheduleInvalid: The schedule has a rule with a wrong time or interval
errors.recordFailed: Could not start recording: Windows did not allow watching the mouse and keyboard
errors.stale: The scenario was already changed somewhere else. Open it again.

errors.agentBusy: The assistant is still answering the previous message.

issues.targetEmpty: The "Window" mode needs a title or a process name
issues.roundsRange: The number of rounds must be at least 1
issues.tooManySteps: The scenario has more than 500 steps
issues.tooDeep: Nesting is deeper than three levels
issues.repeatRange: The number of repeats must be from 1 to 10,000
issues.repeatNotAllowed: This step cannot have a repeat
issues.positionWrongMode: The coordinates were captured in the other mode. Capture the point again.
issues.positionNegative: Coordinates inside the window cannot be negative
issues.notchesRange: The number of wheel notches must be from 1 to 100
issues.colorInvalid: The colour must be written as #RRGGBB
issues.toleranceRange: The tolerance must be from 0 to 255
issues.templateFileMissing: The template file is missing. Capture the template again.
issues.thresholdRange: The similarity threshold must be from 50 to 100 %
issues.areaWrongMode: The search area belongs to the other mode
issues.pollRange: The polling interval must be from 20 to 60,000 ms
issues.onFoundNotAllowed: Clicking the match is only available for the "image found" condition
issues.loopTimesRange: The number of passes must be at least 1
issues.unreachableAfterForever: Steps after this block will not run: it has no "Exit loop" step

codes.resumeWindow: Resumed: the target window is active again ("{name}")
codes.resumeProcess: Resumed: the listed program was closed ("{name}")
codes.scheduleCatchUp: Schedule: catching up a missed run of "{name}"
codes.scheduleMissing: Schedule: a rule points at a deleted scenario or queue
codes.recordSaveFailed: Recorded steps were not saved into "{name}": {reason}
codes.updateInstall: Version {version} is being installed, ClickIt is restarting
codes.harnessTemplate: The assistant saved template {file} for scenario {scenario}

scenarios.deleteText: The scenario and the image templates captured for it will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
scenarios.emptyText: A scenario is a list of steps: clicks, keys, pauses and conditions. Press "Create", give the scenario a name, then add steps by hand or record your own actions.

editor.lockedBanner: The scenario cannot be edited while a run or a recording is in progress
editor.name: Scenario name
editor.modeScreenHint: The click goes to the point of the screen even if another program is there.
editor.modeWindowHint: Coordinates are counted from the top-left corner of the contents of the chosen window.
editor.modeChangeHint: Changing the mode does not convert the coordinates in the steps. Steps with old coordinates are marked with an error: capture their points again.
editor.targetProcessHint: Name of the executable file, for example notepad.exe
editor.targetHint: Fill in one field or both. When both are filled in, a window must match both the title and the process.
editor.stepsHint: Click a step to open its settings. A new step is placed after the selected step of the same list, or at the end of the list if there is none.
editor.stepsEmpty: No steps yet. Add the first step or record your own actions.
editor.limitDepth: A block cannot be added here: nesting is limited to {max} levels
editor.duplicateTooMany: No copy was made: the scenario would have more than {max} steps
editor.duplicateTooDeep: No copy was made: blocks would be nested deeper than {max} levels
editor.deleteBlockTitle: Delete the block with its steps?
editor.deleteBlockText: The block has steps inside ({count}). They will be deleted too.

fields.repeatHint: The pause after the step is applied once, after the last repeat.
fields.notchesHint: One notch is one click of the mouse wheel. From 1 to 100.
fields.textHint: The text is typed as is. ClickIt does not switch the keyboard layout.
fields.waitTimeoutHint: 0 means wait until the scenario is stopped by hand.
fields.ifTimeoutHint: 0 means one check right away. If the condition is met within this time, the "Yes" steps run, otherwise the "No" steps.
fields.offsetHint: In pixels from the centre of the found image. Right and down are positive numbers.
fields.loopWhileHint: The condition is checked once before each pass, without waiting.
fields.breakLoopInfo: Leaves the nearest "Repeat" block around this step. The scenario continues with the step after the block.
fields.stopInfo: Ends the scenario the same way as the "Stop" button.

keyInput.hint: Click the field, then press the key. Keys taken by the system or by the program itself (Esc, Tab, Print Screen, Win) can be picked from the list.

conditions.colorHint: Written as #RRGGBB. The "Capture point" button fills in both the point and the colour.
conditions.toleranceHint: From 0 to 255. With 0 the colour must match exactly.
conditions.templateFailed: The template could not be shown
conditions.templateHint: The template is tied to the screen scale and the window theme it was captured with. Capture it again if they change.
conditions.areaHint: Searching the whole screen may be slow. A smaller area is faster.
conditions.processHint: Name of the executable file, for example notepad.exe

capture.title: Point capture
capture.text: Move the cursor to the point and press {hotkey}
capture.windowNote: The coordinates are stored relative to the chosen window, so it has to be open.

run.cornerHint: Moving the cursor to the top-left corner of the primary monitor stops the run
run.recordNothing: Nothing to record: there were no actions
run.recordTimeLimit: Recording stopped: 10 minute limit. Steps added: {added}
run.recordStepLimit: Recording stopped: the scenario has 500 steps. Steps added: {added}

record.storageHint: Pressed keys and typed text will be stored in the scenario file on this computer.
record.appendHint: Recording appends steps to the end of the scenario. It does not create conditions, branches or loops.

queues.deleteText: The scenarios of the queue stay where they are. Schedule rules that start this queue will stop firing.
queues.emptyText: A queue runs several scenarios in a row, one after another.
queues.brokenMarker: The queue has a deleted scenario
queues.lockedBanner: Queues cannot be edited while a run or a recording is in progress
queues.startBlocked: The queue will not start while it has errors
queues.roundsTitle: How many times in a row to run this scenario
queues.noScenarios: Create at least one scenario first.
queues.roundsHint: One scenario can be added several times. The scenario's own repeat setting is ignored inside a queue: the item's number of rounds is used instead.
queues.failureHint: An item fails when it could not start (the target window was not found, a step has an error) or ended abnormally: a "Stop scenario" step fired, a condition with "Stop the scenario" chosen timed out, the target window was closed or a point was outside the window.
queues.stopHint: The "Stop" button, the hotkey, the "Stop" tray item and the screen corner stop the whole queue, not just one item.
queues.countdownHint: The countdown runs once, before the first item.

schedule.nothingToRun: There is nothing to run yet: create a scenario or a queue first.
schedule.notSaved: The changes are not saved. Fix the rules marked in red or delete them.
schedule.emptyText: A rule starts a scenario or a queue at a set time.
schedule.errTargetMissing: The scenario or queue was deleted. Choose another target or delete the rule.
schedule.errDays: Select at least one day of the week.
schedule.errInterval: The interval must be from {min} to {max} minutes.
schedule.noteLocalTime: The time is local: the clock of this computer.
schedule.noteRunning: Rules fire only while ClickIt is running. Autostart keeps it running after you sign in to Windows.
schedule.noteNoCountdown: A scheduled start has no countdown and no extra confirmation.
schedule.noteSkipped: A start is skipped if something is already running or recording, if a program from the "Do not run while running" list is running, or if the target window of a scenario in the "Window" mode is not found. The reason goes to the journal and to a tray notification.
schedule.noteCatchUp: A missed daily or weekly start is run once after the next launch of ClickIt if less than 12 hours have passed. This can be turned off in the settings. One-time and interval rules are not caught up.
schedule.noteGrid: Interval starts sit on a fixed grid from the start moment: the start, the start plus N minutes and so on.

settings.hotkeyCaptureHint: Active only while point capture is open.
settings.hotkeyHint: Click the field, then press a key, alone or together with Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Win. Esc cancels.
settings.hotkeysLocked: Hotkeys cannot be changed while a run or a recording is in progress.
settings.countdownHint: From 0 to {max} seconds before a manual start, 0 turns it off. A scheduled start never has a countdown.
settings.cornerStop: Stop when the cursor reaches the top-left corner of the primary monitor
settings.autostartHint: After you sign in to Windows, ClickIt appears in the tray without opening its window. The schedule works. Recording never starts by itself.
settings.closeExits: Closing the window quits the application
settings.closeExitsHint: When this is off, closing the window hides it to the tray and ClickIt keeps running.
settings.catchUp: Catch up a missed daily or weekly start after ClickIt is launched
settings.catchUpHint: The start is run once, and only if less than 12 hours have passed since the missed time.
settings.checkUpdatesHint: ClickIt asks GitHub whether a new version is out. An update that is found is downloaded and installed by itself when no run or recording is in progress; ClickIt starts again afterwards. With the box unticked, ClickIt does not contact GitHub by itself. Requests from the assistant to a model are set separately.
settings.harnessHint: While this is on, clickit-mcp can connect to this ClickIt over a local pipe. The connected program receives screenshots and decides itself whether to send them to its model. Actions from that connection show on the Assistant page, on the Connections tab. Turning the box off closes the pipe and the screenshots.
settings.harnessAutoRunHint: While this is off, both clickit-mcp and the Assistant page ask in the ClickIt window before a scenario starts. When it is on, the application presses keys by itself, after the countdown. Stopping still needs no question.
settings.agentKeyHint: An empty address means the Assistant page does not use the network. A request is sent only when you send a message. Screenshots and scenario text go to this address.
settings.agentKeySaved: The key is stored on this computer and is not written to the journal.
settings.blockedHint: The list holds names of executable files such as game.exe. It is empty until you fill it, and an empty list blocks nothing. While at least one listed program is running, a scenario does not start and a running one pauses.
settings.noticePresence: Another program may take into account the mere presence of an automation tool on the computer, even when the clicks do not go to it. ClickIt does not hide its process and does not mask its input. The application does not promise that such a program will not apply sanctions.
settings.noticeAdmin: If the target window runs as administrator, Windows may refuse input from an ordinary process.

journalView.note: The journal covers the current and the previous session of ClickIt. It is kept on this computer and is never sent anywhere.
journalView.emptyText: Starts, stops and skipped scheduled runs will appear here.

modes.title: Two modes
modes.intro: The mode is chosen for each scenario separately.
modes.screenCoords: Coordinates are absolute: points of the desktop across all monitors.
modes.screenNoPause: A change of the active window does not pause the scenario.
modes.screenPoint: The click goes to the point of the screen even if another program is there.
modes.windowTarget: The target window is set by its title, its process name or both.
modes.windowFocus: The window is brought to the foreground before the start.
modes.windowCoords: Coordinates are counted from the contents of the window, without its frame and title bar.
modes.windowPause: While another window is in the foreground, the scenario is paused.
modes.windowOutside: A point outside the window stops the scenario.

steps.title: Steps and pauses
steps.list: A scenario is a list of steps that run in order: a click, a cursor move, a drag, a scroll, a key, typed text, a pause, a wait for a condition.
steps.pause: A step can be followed by a pause in milliseconds: an exact one or a "from–to" range.

cycles.title: Repeats and loops
cycles.stepRepeat: Step repeat: a mouse, keyboard, text or pause step runs from 1 to 10,000 times with a pause between repeats.
cycles.loop: The "Repeat" block: N times, while a condition holds or until stopped.
cycles.exitLoop: The "Exit loop" step leaves the nearest "Repeat" block around it.
cycles.nesting: "If" and "Repeat" blocks can be nested in each other up to three levels deep.
cycles.scenarioRepeat: Scenario repeat: once, N times or until stopped.
cycles.queues: A queue runs several scenarios in a row. Each queue item has its own number of rounds.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.intro: Conditions are used in the "Wait for a condition" step, in the "If" block and in the "Repeat" block.
conditions.pixel: The colour of a pixel, with a tolerance.
conditions.image: An image is found on the screen or is gone from it.
conditions.timing: A check has a polling interval and a timeout.
conditions.timeoutZero: A timeout of 0 in the "Wait for a condition" step means waiting until the scenario is stopped. A timeout of 0 in the "If" block means one check right away.
conditions.template: An image template is tied to the screen scale and the theme. Capture the template again if they change.
conditions.area: A search area makes the image check faster.

ifElse.title: If / else
ifElse.text: The "If" block checks a condition. If it is met, the steps of the "Yes" branch run, otherwise the steps of the "No" branch.

recording.title: Recording
recording.button: Recording starts only by the button and never starts by itself.
recording.badge: While recording is on, the recording badge stays visible on the screen all the time.
recording.keys: Pressed keys and typed text end up in the scenario file on this computer.
recording.limits: Recording is limited to 10 minutes and to 500 steps in the scenario.
recording.shortPauses: Pauses shorter than 50 ms are stored as 0.

startStop.title: Start and stop
startStop.hotkeys: Right now start and stop are on {startStop}, and point and colour capture is on {capture}. The capture key is active only while point capture is open. The keys are changed in the settings.
startStop.countdown: A manual start is preceded by a countdown. Its length is set in the settings, 0 turns it off.
startStop.stopTray: The "Stop" item in the tray icon menu.
startStop.stopCorner: The cursor in the top-left corner of the primary monitor, if this is turned on in the settings.
startStop.release: On a stop, held mouse buttons and keys are released.

harness.title: Assistant
harness.intro: A scenario can be built without doing it by hand. An external program connects through clickit-mcp, and the Assistant page talks to a model inside ClickIt. Both entrances call the same core actions.
harness.mcp: An external program starts clickit-mcp itself and speaks MCP to it. It brings its own model. The pipe is local and is open only while "Allow external connections" is on in the Assistant block. ClickIt does not write that program's settings file: the path to clickit-mcp.exe is set there. An example is in the README. Actions show on the Assistant page, on the Connections tab. The words of the chat stay with the external program. The cross on a tab drops a closed connection. An open one stays until the program disconnects.
harness.assistant: On the Assistant page ClickIt calls the model address from the settings. The address presets are Ollama and LM Studio. A cloud model uses its own address and key. An empty address means the page does not use the network.
harness.shots: With the connection on, the external program receives screenshots. The Assistant page sends screenshots and scenario text to the model address. There is no separate question for each shot.
harness.autoRun: Starting without confirmation is off by default. While the box is unticked, both MCP and the assistant wait for an answer in the ClickIt window. Stopping asks no question.
harness.missing: This version has no queue, schedule, mouse and keyboard recording, or scenario deletion through an external connection.

tray.title: Tray and schedule
tray.tray: When its window is closed, ClickIt stays in the tray unless the settings say otherwise. The tray icon menu opens the window, starts a scenario or a queue, stops a run and quits.
tray.hud: While the window is hidden or minimized, the plaque above the tray stays for the whole run: the countdown, the run, a wait and a pause.
tray.schedule: The schedule starts scenarios and queues at a set time while ClickIt is running. Such a start has no countdown. See the "Schedule" page for details.

updates.title: Updates
updates.check: At startup ClickIt asks GitHub whether a new version is out, if the settings allow it. Separately, the Assistant page contacts the model address when you send a message.
updates.install: An update that is found is downloaded, its signature is checked, and it is installed by itself. ClickIt starts again afterwards.
updates.idle: An update does not interrupt a run or a recording: it waits for them to end.
updates.portable: A copy that runs without installation does not update itself and only tells about the new version.
updates.manual: Updates can be checked by hand on the "About" page.

blocked.title: The "Do not run while running" list
blocked.text: In the settings you can list programs by the name of their executable file. While at least one of them is running, a scenario does not start and a running one pauses. An empty list blocks nothing.

limits.title: Limitations
limits.input: ClickIt sends ordinary Windows input and looks at the picture on the screen. It is meant for forms, office windows and test stands.
limits.noHiding: ClickIt does not hide its process and does not mask its input.
limits.presence: Another program may take the presence of an automation tool on the computer into account. There is no guarantee that it will not apply sanctions.
limits.admin: Windows running as administrator may not accept input from an ordinary process.
limits.layout: The keyboard layout is not switched automatically.

about.description: An auto clicker for Windows: scenarios made of clicks, key presses, pauses and conditions.
about.network: The application has no account and no cloud. It uses the network for updates from GitHub, if the settings allow it or you press "Check for updates", and for the model address on the Assistant page when you send a message.

update.title: Updates
update.idle: Updates have not been checked in this session yet.
update.available: Version {version} is out. This copy runs without installation and cannot update itself. The new version is here: {url}
update.ready: Version {version} is downloaded. It will be installed when the run or the recording ends.
update.installing: Version {version} is being installed. ClickIt is about to restart.
update.failed: The check for updates failed. There may be no internet connection.
update.failedVersion: Version {version} could not be installed. The reason is in the journal.
update.toastAvailable: Version {version} is out. See the "About" page for details.

overlay.regionHint: Drag to select a rectangle. Esc or the right button cancels

agent.limit: The limit was reached: {count} calls for one message. The turn stopped.
agent.needSettings: Set the address and the model name in the settings first.
agent.notice: Screenshots and scenario text go to the address from the settings.
agent.connectionsNotice: The words of the chat stay with the external program. Here are the ClickIt actions for "{client}".
agent.connectionOpen: This connection is still open. The tab can be removed after the external program disconnects.
agent.connectRun: In the settings, in the Assistant block, turn on "Allow external connections". Leave ClickIt running afterwards: the pipe works only while the application is open.
agent.connectClient: This is an external program with its own model. ClickIt does not start it. The program starts clickit-mcp itself and sends requests through it.
agent.connectPath: Replace an empty "mcpServers": {} with the text below. The path already points at clickit-mcp next to this copy of ClickIt. If mcpServers already lists other servers, copy only the clickit entry and add it beside them.
agent.connectMissing: clickit-mcp.exe is not next to this copy of ClickIt. Put it in the same folder: the path in the text already points there.
agent.connectSee: Lines appear here when the external program calls an action: list, edit, screenshot, or start. Until there is a call, the list stays empty.
